thread:
mike: CI image publish is intermittently failing after my .dockerignore tweak. kaniko jobs hang on finalize and we see HTTP 423 / blob locked in registry logs. example from the pipeline:
```
PUT /v2/myorg/app/blobs/uploads/uuid?digest=sha256:... -> 423 Locked
error: failed to finalize upload: server returned status 423
```
Anyone seen GC / lock races like this recently?

sara: yep — 423 usually means the registry GC grabbed the layer while the upload was in progress. we had a similar flake during the storage incident last month.

tash: pipeline id? we can correlate with registry gc window.

mike: pipeline: https://ci.redwood.dev/pipe/4567 — failure at 03:12 UTC. my change was just removing a couple of files from .dockerignore so the context grew by ~50KB, weird that it triggers this.

david: tagging eng-sre to look at GC timing ¯\_(ツ)_/¯. ops-jen any visibility on GC jobs?

ops-jen: registry GC runs daily at 03:10 UTC on the registry-primary host (cron: 10 3 * * *). last run started 03:10:05 and took ~8m due to backlog. that overlaps with the pipeline window. I'll check GC logs for lock churn.

ci-bot: rerun triggered by @mike — pipeline 4567 rerun -> job 4567.2 queued.

sara: quick mitigation: kaniko and buildx both tolerate retries on finalize. add 5x exponential backoff on PUT/patch finalize and it masked the issue for us last time. also you can add a randomized jitter so many concurrent pushes don't all retry at once.

tash: ops-jen — if GC is taking that long maybe it holds locks for longer. any chance we can throttle GC concurrency or shift to 02:30 to avoid daily CI peak?

ops-jen: yep can shift, but want to confirm scope. i'll pull registry logs and list active locks around 03:10. give me ~20m.

david: also worth bisecting: revert mike's .dockerignore locally and try pushing same image from CI to confirm it's the timing + context size combo and not some digest collision. mike can you run a rerun with revert?

mike: starting a quick revert test on a branch now. if that passes i'll open a revert PR.

sara: short-term hotfix: can we add a buildkite/kaniko wrapper that does this for all pushes: retry-finalize.sh which runs finalize with 5 retries and sleep jitter? we can land that fast.

david: +1. i'll draft the wrapper and open a small PR against infra-ci today.

ops-jen: pulled registry logs — confirmed multiple GC sweeps overlapping uploads at 03:10:05 -> 03:18:00. saw lock churn and a few 423s exactly matching pipeline timestamps. shifting GC to 02:30 would avoid CI push window (02:58-03:30). I'll propose change and schedule a quiet maintenance window.

mike: revert test failed too (same 423). looks like timing is the culprit. thanks all.

sara: ok plan: 1) ops-jen will shift GC to 02:30 and monitor for one week. 2) david will add retry wrapper PR for kaniko finalize (short-term protection). 3) mike will keep his .dockerignore change; if retries + GC shift makes things green we don't revert.

ops-jen: notes: GC schedule PR -> infra-ops repo, will include a brief note about why (reduce push conflicts).

david: PR opened: https://git.redwood.dev/infra/ci/-/merge_requests/128 add retry-finalize.sh. minimal change, runs in front of kaniko.

mike: re-ran pipeline after david's wrapper patch applied in CI -> success. marking this resolved for now. thanks folks :thumbsup:

sara: will keep monitoring flakiness in SLO dashboard; if we still see >1% push 423s we'll escalate to a larger storage backend review.

ops-jen: GC shift merged and scheduled, will post follow-up if any residuals.

ci-bot: pipeline 4567.2 succeeded (after retry wrapper).

mike: closing the thread, filing followup ticket for long-term storage compaction review.
